profiles.title: Edit and save a parameter profile
profiles.description: Input catalog v1: model units, ranges and sources. Only the isolated experiment is changed. Unchecked optional inputs preserve the original defaults.
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.help: A saved version cannot be overwritten with different values. Increase the version to edit. Export a file to transfer it between browsers.
profiles.invalid: Check the profile fields before continuing.
profiles.busy: Wait for or cancel the experiment before changing its plan.
profiles.applied: Profile {profile} applied. The experiment seed and duration were preserved.
profiles.readDone: Current plan values loaded into the editor.
profiles.sweepBusy: Stop the sweep before changing its base.
profiles.sweepDone: Profile applied to the sweep base. The seed, duration and comparison values were preserved.
profiles.loaded: Version loaded into the editor. Apply it to use it in the experiment.
profiles.exported: Profile exported. Keep the seed and Viveiro version as well to reproduce it.
profiles.imported: Profile imported and saved. Apply it to run with these values.
profiles.source: Range: {min} to {max} {unit}. Source: src/modules/{source}. {kind}; without species calibration.
